notes.title: ver0.1.9 - Update
notes.content:
Additions
Added “Difficulty 3” to each stage.

Added a “Lock” feature to the shop.

Locked items will continue to appear in future shop visits.


Improvements
Overall adjustments to weapon evolution effects.

Overall adjustments to artifact effects.

Added possession limits for each artifact.

Artifacts that have reached their limit will no longer appear as options.

Adjusted so that normal enemies also spawn when elite enemies appear.

Adjusted so that after a boss enemy appears, a large number of enemies spawn alongside enemy enhancements.

Added display of remaining ammo and reload status above the character’s head.

Adjusted status ailment descriptions to provide more detailed information.

Adjusted the maximum armor value for characters to “70.”

Adjusted the maximum dodge rate for characters to “70%.”

Adjusted the UI.

Other minor improvements.


Bug Fixes
Adjusted localization for various texts.

Fixed garbled text issues.

Fixed a bug where “Reroll” would not appear when evolving a weapon in the shop.

Improved the visibility of damage number texts.

Other minor bug fixes.

notes.title: ver0.1.8 - Update
notes.content:
Improvements
Adjusted character selection and deployment behavior when using a controller.

Other minor improvements.


Bug Fixes
Fixed an issue where enemies could spawn outside the map.

Fixed an issue where weapons that had already reached max level could still appear as level-up options.

Fixed an issue where slimes could be unintentionally destroyed at the start of a stage.

Other minor bug fixes.

notes.title: ver0.1.7 - Update
notes.content:
Improvements
Added detailed effect descriptions to each status ailment.

Adjusted to make it clear when effect duration increases upon acquiring duplicate status effects.

Other minor improvements.


Bug Fixes
Fixed an issue where some character and weapon stats displayed during pause were incorrect.

Fixed an issue where the level-up option for "Fish Bullet" was not displayed.

Other minor bug fixes.

notes.title: ver0.1.6 - Update
notes.content:
Improvements
Adjusted the stats and effects of the "Bow" weapon.

Added object indicators such as "Treasure Chests" to the minimap.

Adjusted so that chickens drop a certain amount of crystals.

Adjusted so that when maximum HP increases, the same amount of HP is gained.

Increased the spawn rate of mission-related objects.

Made minor stat adjustments to some weapons.


Bug Fixes
Fixed an issue where an error would occur when upgrading to the maximum level using the enhancement feature.

Fixed an issue where artifacts would sometimes not drop after defeating a floor boss.

Other minor bug fixes.

notes.title: ver0.1.5 - Update
notes.content:
Improvements
Supports mouse controls.

Added a "Start" button to the character selection screen.

Adjusted the prices of some cards in the "Card Shop".


Bug Fixes
Fixed an issue where increases in "Pickup Range" were not being applied correctly.

Fixed an issue where the effects of equipped "Cards" were not being applied properly.
